name: Improved Precise Strike [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your precise timing and smooth teamwork allow your allies to strike a foe where it hurts.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Precise Strike, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Whenever your ally deals additional damage with Precise Strike, they also deal 1 point of bleed damage. This bleed damage does not stack with itself.

Polymorph: Spiritual Ally, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: G. Tyler Ernst.
